question: Sandhya has only one daughter. Sukhi's sister, Reena, is Sandhya's maternal aunt. Sukhi's mother, Bruna, has only two great-granddaughters, Anum and Jasmine. Reena has two grandchildren, Rohan and Anum. Who is Sandhya's daughter?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) Sukhi's sister, Reena, is Sandhya's maternal aunt.

2) Sandhya has only one daughter.

As the gender of the person cannot be determined based on the name, therefore the gender of Sandhya cannot be determined yet.

As Sukhi's sister, Reena, is Sandhya's maternal aunt, and Sukhi gender is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1) Sukhi is the mother of Sandhya

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38c0076691620b37f62d4ef227d655264e58865be6a7aaa1e0fc8723469c8db9.png] 

Case 2) Sukhi is the sibling of the Sandhya's mother

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bad831e41057bcd30f8bcd4452c36a8bc1762dd0f553c30be72fd39bf4ceaf3.png] 

3) Reena has two grandchildren, Rohan and Anum.

4) Sukhi's mother, Bruna, has only two great-granddaughters, Anum and Jasmine. 

Case 1)

Case 2)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
